PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

ESG & sustainability professional with 12 years' total experience - around 5 focused on ESG advisory, reporting and disclosure, assurance, GHG accounting and decarbonisation; client-facing across India, EU and US.

Advisory across the career: Advisory to client ESG strategy, reporting readiness/report preparation and decarbonisation roadmaps at Tech Mahindra, SGA and non-conflicted advisory (independence maintained) alongside assurance at DNV.

Assurance as a backstop: ISO 14064 GHG Lead Verifier and ISAE 3000 assurance experience across 24+ listed corporates, including the reporting and GHG inventories along with other environmental, social and governance KPIs.

Ratings & submissions: Coordinated Eco Vadis, CDP and DJSI submissions; hands-on GHG Protocol Scope 1/2/3 carbon accounting and LCA

Sector coverage: Pharma & life sciences, Financial services, IT/services, F&B, Logistics and retail - across advisory, in-house and assurance work.

CORE COMPETENCIES

Advisory & Strategy: ESG strategy & roadmaps · Reporting framework readiness · Double materiality · Decarbonisation roadmaps · Internal carbon pricing · Climate risk & scenario analysis Reporting & Disclosure: GRI · BRSR / BRSR Core · CSRD / ESRS · TCFD · CDP · SASB · IFRS S1/S2 · Integrated Reporting · UN SDGs Ratings & Submissions: EcoVadis · CDP · DJSI · WBA GHG & Carbon: GHG Protocol Scope 1/2/3 · ISO 14064 (Lead Verifier) · Carbon accounting · LCA / product carbon footprint · SBTi (working knowledge) Assurance & Data: ISAE 3000 · ISO 14064 verification · ESG data governance & controls · Audit readiness · Gap assessments Delivery & Tools: Multi-site engagement delivery · Budget & milestone management · Power BI dashboards · Advanced Excel · LCA & ESG reporting platforms (working knowledge) · Stakeholder engagement · ESG training Sector coverage: Pharma & life sciences · Financial services · IT / services · F&B · Retail · Infrastructure & industrials

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Senior Assessor – Sustainability (Advisory & Assurance) | DNV Business Assurance India Pvt Ltd, HyderabadJul 2024 – Jul 2026 Advisory (separate, non-conflicted clients - assurance independence maintained) • ESG data governance & reporting readiness: Advised clients on ESG data governance, internal controls and reporting processes, enabling BRSR compliance and GRI alignment; ran GRI / BRSR readiness and gap assessments across 45+ indicators. • GHG & decarbonisation advisory: Developed GHG inventories and emission profiles on advisory engagements and advised on

decarbonisation and energy-transition observations within client climate transition plans.

Materiality & disclosure: Ran GRI / CSRD-aligned double materiality assessments and stakeholder engagement, identifying material topics and scoping TCFD-aligned climate-related disclosures.

Independent assurance & verification (ISAE 3000 · ISO 14064) • Independent assurance: Delivered ISAE 3000 (Revised) limited and reasonable assurance over sustainability disclosures for

24+ listed corporates, against GRI, BRSR Core and entity-defined criteria.

GHG verification: Verified Scope 1/2/3 GHG inventories (GHG Protocol / ISO 14064) across 75+ manufacturing and industrial sites over two reporting years, testing activity data, emission factors and calculation methodology, on-site and by desk review. • Findings, supply chain & reporting: Raised 12–15 findings per engagement and 20+ per gap assessment; led tier-1 supplier ESG due diligence to 95% control-gap closure within a quarter; presented findings and remediation roadmaps via Power BI to C- suite and audit committees at 10+ organisations, with ~80% of clients improving data quality in the next cycle. Aug 2022 – Jun 2024

GHG verification: Verified Scope 1/2/3 GHG inventories (GHG Protocol / ISO 14064) across 75+ manufacturing and industrial sites over two reporting years, testing activity data, emission factors and calculation methodology, on-site and by desk review. • Findings, supply chain & reporting: Raised 12–15 findings per engagement and 20+ per gap assessment; led tier-1 supplier ESG due diligence to 95% control-gap closure within a quarter; presented findings and remediation roadmaps via Power BI to C- suite and audit committees at 10+ organisations, with ~80% of clients improving data quality in the next cycle. Aug 2022 – Jun 2024

framing assessments and translating framework requirements into actionable implementation plans.

Business development & delivery: Converted two client engagements worth ~US$105K combined, a cradle-to-gate LCA programme ($85K, 8 months) and a sustainability-reporting advisory engagement ($30K); scoped, budgeted and delivered end- to-end, presented digital tech and advisory solutions at CSO / CTO / Sustainability leadership levels for ESG initiatives, data tracking, and reporting.

Corporate reporting, ratings & carbon (in-house — Tech Mahindra) • Corporate reporting: Tech Mahindra's in-house sustainability reporting and BRSR and contributed to the Integrated Report (<IR> Framework) aligned with GRI, SASB, DJSI, TCFD and UN SDGs - KPI data collection, framework mapping and disclosure drafting across business units.

• EcoVadis, CDP & DJSI: Coordinated Tech Mahindra's EcoVadis submission and contributed to CDP and DJSI disclosures, compiling and validating data and driving performance improvement across environment, labour, ethics and sustainable- procurement themes.

• Carbon management & enablement: Contributed to internal carbon-pricing framework development and applied MAC-curve abatement prioritisation to decarbonisation planning; completed PSCI supplier self-assessments as a service supplier to pharma clients; delivered 4–5 sustainability training sessions reaching 25+ stakeholders each.

Lead Analyst – ESG Research & Solutions | SG Analytics, Pune • Advisory report preparation (financial sector): Led a 5-analyst team on ESG / sustainability report preparation for financial-

Jan 2022 – Jul 2022

institution clients, overseeing disclosure alignment and framework mapping through a structured QC process.

Regulatory & benchmarking: Executed SFDR and EU Taxonomy alignment and ESG ratings/controversy screening across 120+ portfolios; directed ESG benchmarking of the top 50 F&B companies against the World Benchmarking Alliance framework. May 2018 – Dec 2021

Regulatory & benchmarking: Executed SFDR and EU Taxonomy alignment and ESG ratings/controversy screening across 120+ portfolios; directed ESG benchmarking of the top 50 F&B companies against the World Benchmarking Alliance framework. May 2018 – Dec 2021

Stakeholders & budgets: Ran structured stakeholder and community consultation across 7+ projects; managed project budgets (~US$100K) with milestone invoicing and utilisation tracking; Reported CSR and socio-economic baseline studies

Consulting Environmental Engineer | Universal Enviro Associates, Hyderabad • Delivered environmental monitoring and assessment programmes (air, water, waste, emissions, socio-economic) across industrial sites; identified opportunities through tender analysis and mentored junior team members.

Master's, Environmental Engineering & Management - Erasmus Mundus Joint Programme, EU Consortium Universities • M.Tech, Environmental Management - JNTU Hyderabad • M.Sc., Environmental Science - Yeshwant Mahavidyalaya, Nanded • B.Sc., Botany, Zoology & Chemistry (Environmental Science) - Osmania University • (PhD ) Doctoral research, Environmental Science - University College Dublin

CERTIFICATIONS

ISO 14064-1/2/3 - GHG Lead Verifier / Lead Validator - SGS • Sustainability & Climate Risk SCR - (GARP) • Executive Programme in ESG Strategy & Leadership - IIM Kashipur & NSE Academy • Climate Scenario Analyst – (Corpstage Academy) • Net Zero Practitioner - IICSR • ISO 14001 EMS - internal training (DNV)
